# Reflection

The in-class activity gave the group practical experience working together in one shared GitHub repository. Dividing the objectives among the five members made each person’s responsibility clear, while the commit history provided visible evidence of individual participation. The activity also reinforced the importance of pulling the latest version before editing, using descriptive commit messages, and communicating with teammates to reduce conflicting changes. Overall, the group established an organized foundation for developing Chapter 1 after meeting with the client.
